title: habenaria tipuloides
intro: Habenaria tipuloides, commonly known as the Indian snake grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Habenaria tipuloides include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, soothing inflammation, and relieving respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
